decisions.reason: As a close extension of the hearing-systems business that survived its first market test, it likely meets a satisficing aspiration level and remains worth keeping.
This unit fits the firm's integrated equipment-and-materials workflow and, absent clear signs of underperformance, management would continue it while using existing capabilities.

Because it is distant from the core offer its aspiration hurdle is harder to justify and withdrawal risk is relatively high, but with only one year of experience and some organisational slack the firm would likely keep it for now.
The post-curing unit is close to the firm's digital manufacturing trajectory and likely benefits from system complementarities, so it would usually be retained unless results clearly fall short.
